description_target.target_text: Erase each object and keep only the background cells one orthogonal step outside it, colored like the object that touches them.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))

    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (obj< a b)
      (let ((ba (obj-bbox a)) (bb (obj-bbox b)))
        (if (= (first ba) (first bb)) (< (second ba) (second bb)) (< (first ba) (first bb)))))
    (define (nonzero-cells grid)
      (sort (filter (lambda (cell) (not (= (third cell) 0))) (grid-cells grid))
            (lambda (a b) (cell< (list (first a) (second a)) (list (first b) (second b))))))
    (define (points-of grid color)
      (sort (find-color grid color) cell<))
    (define (bbox-h bb) (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb))))
    (define (bbox-w bb) (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb))))
    (define (bbox-cells bb)
      (positions-in-rect (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb)))
    (define (sign n)
      (cond [(> n 0) 1] [(< n 0) -1] [else 0]))
    (define (clear-between? grid a b)
      (let* ((r1 (first a)) (c1 (second a))
             (r2 (first b)) (c2 (second b))
             (dr (sign (- r2 r1)))
             (dc (sign (- c2 c1)))
             (n (max (abs (- r2 r1)) (abs (- c2 c1)))))
        (all? (lambda (k) (= (at grid (+ r1 (* k dr)) (+ c1 (* k dc))) 0))
              (range 1 n))))
    (define (rect-frame? grid obj)
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (r1 (first bb)) (c1 (second bb))
             (r2 (third bb)) (c2 (fourth bb))
             (h (bbox-h bb)) (w (bbox-w bb))
             (color (obj-color obj))
             (perim (- (+ (* 2 h) (* 2 w)) 4)))
        (and (= color 5)
             (>= h 3)
             (>= w 3)
             (= (obj-size obj) perim)
             (all? (lambda (c) (= (at grid r1 c) 5)) (range c1 (+ c2 1)))
             (all? (lambda (c) (= (at grid r2 c) 5)) (range c1 (+ c2 1)))
             (all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c1) 5)) (range r1 (+ r2 1)))
             (all? (lambda (r) (= (at grid r c2) 5)) (range r1 (+ r2 1))))))
    (define (crop-cells cells [color 8])
      (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
             (r1 (first bb)) (c1 (second bb))
             (r2 (third bb)) (c2 (fourth bb))
             (norm (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) r1) (- (second p) c1))) cells)))
        (paint-cells (empty-grid (+ 1 (- r2 r1)) (+ 1 (- c2 c1)) 0) norm color)))
    (define (object-grid obj [grid #f])
      (if grid
          (subgrid grid (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj) (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c2 obj))
          (paint-cells (empty-grid (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj) 0) (normalize-cells (obj-cells obj)) (obj-color obj))))
    (define (crop-nonzero-below-top grid)
      (let* ((cells (filter (lambda (cell) (and (> (first cell) 0) (not (= (third cell) 0)))) (grid-cells grid)))
             (pts (map (lambda (cell) (list (first cell) (second cell))) cells))
             (bb (bbox-of-cells pts)))
        (subgrid grid (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))
    (define (apply-transform sub code)
      (cond [(= code 1) (rotate-cw sub)]
            [(= code 2) (flip-lr sub)]
            [(= code 3) (rotate-180 sub)]
            [(= code 4) (flip-ud sub)]
            [else sub]))
    (define (hconcat-all grids)
      (if (empty? (rest grids)) (first grids) (foldl (lambda (g acc) (hconcat acc g)) (first grids) (rest grids))))
    (define (pad-grid-to grid h w)
      (grid-from-fn h w
        (lambda (r c)
          (if (and (< r (rows grid)) (< c (cols grid))) (at grid r c) 0))))
    (define (hconcat-spaced grids)
      (let* ((h (apply max (map rows grids)))
             (padded (map (lambda (grid) (pad-grid-to grid h (cols grid))) grids))
             (spacer (empty-grid h 1 0)))
        (let add ((remaining padded) (acc (list)))
          (if (empty? remaining)
              (hconcat-all (reverse acc))
              (add (rest remaining)
                   (if (empty? acc)
                       (cons (first remaining) acc)
                       (cons (first remaining) (cons spacer acc))))))))
    (define (stamp-grid-nonzero out sub tr tc)
      (foldl (lambda (cell acc)
               (let ((r (+ tr (first cell)))
                     (c (+ tc (second cell)))
                     (v (third cell)))
                 (if (and (not (= v 0)) (in-bounds? r c (rows acc) (cols acc)))
                     (set-cell acc r c v)
                     acc)))
             out
             (grid-cells sub)))
    (define (grow-square grid cells)
      (remove-duplicates
       (filter (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows grid) (cols grid)))
               (flatmap (lambda (p)
                          (for*/list ([dr (in-range -1 2)] [dc (in-range -1 2)])
                            (list (+ (first p) dr) (+ (second p) dc))))
                        cells))))
    (define (orthogonal-neighbor-cells grid cells)
      (remove-duplicates
       (filter (lambda (p) (in-bounds? (first p) (second p) (rows grid) (cols grid)))
               (flatmap (lambda (p)
                          (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d))))
                               cardinal-deltas))
                        cells))))
    (define (line-ray grid start d)
      (let loop ((r (+ (first start) (first d))) (c (+ (second start) (second d))) (acc (list)))
        (cond [(not (in-bounds? r c (rows grid) (cols grid))) (reverse acc)]
              [(not (= (at grid r c) 0)) (reverse acc)]
              [else (loop (+ r (first d)) (+ c (second d)) (cons (list r c) acc))])))
    (define (portal-color? v)
      (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 2)) (not (= v 3)) (not (= v 5))))
    (define (shape-key cells)
      (first (sort (map (lambda (cs) (format "~a" cs)) (all-transforms cells)) string<?)))
    (define (norm-key cells)
      (format "~a" (sort (normalize-cells cells) cell<)))
    (define (first-matching-transform candidate target-key)
      (first (filter (lambda (cells) (equal? (norm-key cells) target-key)) (all-transforms candidate))))
    (define (padded-object-crop grid obj hub)
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (r1 (first bb)) (c1 (second bb))
             (r2 (third bb)) (c2 (fourth bb))
             (dr (- (+ r1 r2) (* 2 (first hub))))
             (dc (- (+ c1 c2) (* 2 (second hub))))
             (nr1 r1)
             (nr2 (if (< (bbox-h bb) 3) (min (- (rows grid) 1) (+ r2 1)) r2))
             (wide-special (or (= (obj-color obj) 6)
                               (and (= (obj-color obj) 2) (< (bbox-h bb) 3) (= (bbox-w bb) 3))))
             (left-extra (or wide-special (and (< (bbox-w bb) 3) (or (< dc 0) (> dr 0)))))
             (nc1 (if left-extra (max 0 (- c1 1)) c1))
             (nc2 (if (and (not left-extra) (< (bbox-w bb) 3)) (min (- (cols grid) 1) (+ c2 1)) c2)))
        (subgrid grid nr1 nc1 nr2 nc2)))
    (define (angle-before? a b hub)
      (let* ((ba (obj-bbox a))
             (bb (obj-bbox b))
             (dra (- (+ (first ba) (third ba)) (* 2 (first hub))))
             (dca (- (+ (second ba) (fourth ba)) (* 2 (second hub))))
             (drb (- (+ (first bb) (third bb)) (* 2 (first hub))))
             (dcb (- (+ (second bb) (fourth bb)) (* 2 (second hub))))
             (ha (>= dca 0))
             (hb (>= dcb 0))
             (xa (- dra))
             (ya dca)
             (xb (- drb))
             (yb dcb)
             (cross (- (* xa yb) (* ya xb))))
        (if (not (equal? ha hb))
            ha
            (if (= cross 0) (obj< a b) (> cross 0)))))
    (define (angle-sector obj hub)
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (dr (- (+ (first bb) (third bb)) (* 2 (first hub))))
             (dc (- (+ (second bb) (fourth bb)) (* 2 (second hub)))))
        (cond [(and (< dr 0) (<= (abs dc) (abs dr))) 0]
              [(and (> dc 0) (> (abs dc) (abs dr))) 1]
              [(and (> dr 0) (>= (abs dr) (abs dc))) 2]
              [else 3])))
    (define (gallery-pack crops)
      (hconcat-all crops))

    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([obj (in-list (objects g 0))])
      (let* ((neighbors (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 0))
                                (orthogonal-neighbor-cells g (obj-cells obj)))))
        (paint-cells out neighbors (obj-color obj))))
  ))

(first p) (second p) (rows grid) (cols grid))) (flatmap (lambda (p) (map (lambda (d) (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))) cardinal-deltas)) cells)))) (for/fold ((out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0))) ((obj (in-list (objects g 0)))) (let* ((neighbors (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 0)) (orthogonal-neighbor-cells g (obj-cells obj))))) (paint-cells out neighbors (obj-color obj))))))
